Capabilities

  • New

    New capability for the whole software: it may now read the clock.

    Nothing in the previous version could.

  • New

    Directly in cart::Cart.audit.

  • New

Business rules

  • New

    New rule: Percent must be zero or greater. Percent must be at most 100.

    Applies to pricing::rebate.

    Technical details
  • Changed

    Rule changed: Unit must be zero or greater.

    Was: Unit must be positive. Applies to pricing::total.

    Technical details
  • Removed

    Rule removed: Percent must be zero or greater.

    Applied to pricing::discount.
